instruction: A minimalist lifestyle photograph with a full shot captures a bright, clean indoor studio with white walls and a potted olive tree. On the left, the man in the black suit (R2) sits in a modern white armchair, holding a laptop on his lap and looking toward his colleague. On the right, the woman in the white shirt and black vest (R1) sits on a textured white block, holding a black clipboard and looking down at her notes. The two are positioned a few feet apart, engaged in a quiet, collaborative workspace interaction. The scene is illuminated by soft, diffused natural light, creating a bright, neutral color palette with minimal shadows and a clean, professional atmosphere.
